## Description {#details}

<p>Base class for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/blockfrequencyinfoimpl">BlockFrequencyInfoImpl</a>.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/blockfrequencyinfoimplbase">BlockFrequencyInfoImplBase</a> has supporting data structures and some algorithms for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/blockfrequencyinfoimplbase">BlockFrequencyInfoImplBase</a>. Only algorithms that depend on the block type (or that call such algorithms) are skipped here.</p>


<p>Nevertheless, the majority of the overall algorithm documentation lives with <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/blockfrequencyinfoimpl">BlockFrequencyInfoImpl</a>. See there for details.</p>


<p>Definition at line 180 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/blockfrequencyinfoimpl-h">BlockFrequencyInfoImpl.h</a>.</p>

### adjustLoopHeaderMass() {#af8aa6262fff3f09a8e2076d7a76e1628}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Adjust the mass of all headers in an irreducible loop.</p>


<p>Initially, irreducible loops are assumed to distribute their mass equally among its headers. This can lead to wrong frequency estimates since some headers may be executed more frequently than others.</p>


<p>This adjusts header mass distribution so it matches the weights of the backedges going into each of the loop headers.</p>
